scene: You scramble up creaky bamboo planks overlooking the dazzling, sunlit rooftops.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide wooden scaffold platform high up. On the far left sits a closed, neon-pink lunchbox. The Pacific Islander girl stands centre holding her sketchbook. To her right hangs a coiled yellow rope tied to a beam, and on the far right a masked painter rests on a crate.
shown: a metal lunchbox glowing neon pink, sitting latched on the far left plank
a coiled yellow pulley rope hanging securely on the right platform edge
a smiling painter in splattered overalls sitting idle on the far right
